title: OTA audit record
description: ota-state/<appVersion>/v<N>/audit.json: one tamper-evident audit record per immutable state version, written by ota-cli. DESIGN.md 7.1. TypeScript type `AuditRecord` in packages/ota-core/src/types.ts. NOT expressible: prevAuditHash must equal sha256(canonical JSON of the previous record) and previousVersion = stateVersion-1 chain integrity (checked by verifyAuditChain in ota-core); `approver` may be null only for halt, init and break-glass.

stateVersion.description: State version N this record belongs to (the folder v<N>).

previousVersion.description: The previous state version; null for the first record (init).

prevAuditHash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the previous version's audit record; null for the first record. Tamper-evident hash chain.

command.description: The deploy-job command that produced this state version.

unit.description: Unit the command targeted ("host" for the host lane); null for init and whole-state restore.

patchId.description: Patch entry id `<unit>-pr<N>`; null for init and restore.

params.description: Command-specific parameters, e.g. { "percent": 10, "platforms": ["android"] } or { "releaseTag": "v11.9.0" } for init. Free-form object.

approver.description: Identity that approved it; null only for halt (needs no approval), init and break-glass.

breakGlass.description: True when the command used the break-glass path (flagged for review). Absent otherwise.

ticket.description: Jira ticket key, e.g. "CAB-1"; null when not applicable.

pr.description: ota-deployments PR number; null when not applicable.

sourceSha.description: Source commit the patch was built from; null when not applicable.

jobUrl.description: URL of the CI job that ran the command; null when unknown.
